steps.label: Lade Szene
steps.run: curl -fsSL -o ctpack.zip 'https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38Z8oWSnRHNn2APJObaAQyRFvxH/4d4eb1bf-ef50-4fb8-99db-f2d675d7523c.zip' && rm -rf ct tex assets && unzip -oq ctpack.zip && ls ct

steps.label: Patch
steps.run: /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b --factory-startup --python-expr "p='ct/scene.py'; s=open(p).read(); s=s.replace(\"; sc.view_settings.look = 'AgX - Medium High Contrast'\", '\ntry: sc.view_settings.look = \"AgX - Medium High Contrast\"\nexcept Exception as e: print(\"look skip\", e)'); open(p,'w').write(s); compile(s,p,'exec'); print('PATCHED')" 2>&1 | grep PATCHED

steps.label: Patch2
steps.run:
cat > fix2.py <<'EOF_FIX'
p='ct/render.py'; s=open(p).read()
a="    sc.render.image_settings.file_format = 'FFMPEG'"
assert a in s
s=s.replace(a, "    if hasattr(sc.render.image_settings, 'media_type'): sc.render.image_settings.media_type = 'VIDEO'\n"+a)
b="    sc.render.ffmpeg.constant_rate_factor = 'PERC_LOSSLESS'; sc.render.ffmpeg.ffmpeg_preset = 'GOOD'"
assert b in s
s=s.replace(b, "    try:\n        sc.render.ffmpeg.constant_rate_factor = 'PERC_LOSSLESS'; sc.render.ffmpeg.ffmpeg_preset = 'GOOD'\n    except Exception as e: print('ff skip', e)")
compile(s,p,'exec'); open(p,'w').write(s); print('PATCHED2')
EOF_FIX
/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b --factory-startup --python fix2.py 2>&1 | grep PATCHED2

steps.label: Baue 3D-Szene
steps.run: CT_ROOT=$PWD /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P ct/scene.py > build.log 2>&1; tail -5 build.log; grep -q 'SCENE OK' build.log

steps.label: Rendere 999 Frames (Metal GPU)
steps.run: rm -f out_*.mp4 out.mp4; CT_ROOT=$PWD /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b ct/scene.blend -P ct/render.py -- mac $PWD/out_ 12 1 999 > render.log 2>&1; grep -E 'DEVICES|MAC RENDER DONE|Error' render.log | head -5; f=$(ls out_*.mp4 | head -1); test -n "$f" && mv "$f" out.mp4 && ls -la out.mp4
